mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have fair conditions at 70 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park. For space enthusiasts, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 5:02 PM. You can spot it rising in the northwest over Verona High School and tracking toward the northeast near Home Depot, staying low on the horizon.

Important information regarding your property taxes has been released. Tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15. Residents have the option to pay in two installments, with the first due by January 31. Payments can be made via mail, online, or at the 24/7 drop box located at the City Center.

We have a busy schedule for our residents. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
Reviewing local activity, on November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot where one driver was arrested for O W I with a minor passenger in the vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The Verona location is currently open for business and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
